public.title: MobX
public.description: input {initial,operations}; initial maps safe string keys to integers. Operations: autorun {id,keys} subscribes a new ID to a nonempty distinct key list and immediately emits [id,sumOfKeys]; set {key,value} updates an existing key and reruns, in registration order, only active subscriptions reading that key when its value actually changes; dispose {id} removes it. Return all emissions. Each sum is recomputed from current state. This explicit dependency-list model omits dynamic dependency discovery and real proxies. Supported inputs are valid for this contract. Aggregate JSON-serialized input is at most 512 UTF-8 bytes, nesting depth at most 6, arrays at most 40 items, operation/call lists at most 20 items, and individual strings at most 100 ASCII characters unless a tighter bound is stated. Integers have absolute value at most 1000; output arithmetic stays within safe integers. String object keys and string path segments are nonempty safe alphanumeric/underscore names excluding __proto__, constructor and prototype. Empty arrays/objects are allowed where consistent with the contract. Output ordering follows the rules above. These bounds include all nested payloads and all operations together.
hints: Separate the documented JSON representation from the behavior being modeled.

explanation: Store subscriptions with explicit dependency sets and notify changed-key dependents in insertion order. O(operations times subscriptions times keys) time and O(state plus subscriptions plus log) space. Functional tests check the documented adapter behavior; they do not enforce implementation technique or prohibit built-in APIs.
